{"id":2,"hook_type":"myth","hook":"Recovery is not a reward.","spoken":"Recovery is not a reward. It starts tonight. Put tomorrow's workout clothes by the door, before you brush your teeth. {"id":3,"hook_type":"pain-then-relief","hook":"Skipped your workout?","spoken":"Skipped your workout? Do this at ten p.m. Lie on the floor, legs up the wall, two minutes. Breathe slowly through your nose. No guilt, no catching up. The day is done, and your body can settle. {"id":4,"hook_type":"mistake","hook":"The mistake: bright lights at bedtime.","spoken":"The mistake: bright lights at bedtime. An hour before sleep, switch off the big ceiling light. Use one lamp instead, low and warm. Dim light tells your body the day is ending. Small change, calmer evening. Follow for more evening habits.","captions":["Mistake: bright lights","Ceiling light off","One warm lamp","Low and warm","Day is ending","Follow for evening habits"],"cta":"FOLLOW","visuals":["bright overhead light in a bedroom, harsh","hand pressing a wall switch off","single warm table lamp in a dark room","close-up of lamp glow on a wall","window with dusk sky","cozy bedroom with soft lamp light"],"tania":["doubt","serious","thoughtful","joy","thoughtful","joy"],"why":"A visible contrast (harsh light, then warm lamp) shows the fix in one second, with no sound needed."},
{"id":5,"hook_type":"anti-hook","hook":"Don't try to sleep yet.","spoken":"Don't try to sleep yet. First, stand by a window for one minute. Look at something far away. Breathe out slowly, longer than you breathe in. Your shoulders drop without effort. Then go to bed. Save this for the nights you feel wired.","captions":["Don't try to sleep yet","One minute at a window","Look far away","Long breath out","Shoulders drop","Save for wired nights"],"cta":"SAVE","visuals":["woman lying awake in bed, phone glow off","person standing at a night window","city lights in the distance through glass","slow breath mist on a cool window","relaxed shoulders, back view","bed with soft blanket turned down"],"tania":["surprise","thoughtful","thoughtful","serious","joy","joy"],"why":"It goes against what everyone expects (stop forcing sleep) and promises a tiny step for the wired-at-night feeling."},
{"id":6,"hook_type":"open loop","hook":"A one-minute habit. Wait for it.","spoken":"A one-minute habit. Wait for it. Tonight, write tomorrow's one priority on a sticky note. Just one. Stick it on your mirror. Your mind has less to rehearse, and bedtime gets quieter. That was it. Follow for small habits like this.","captions":["A one-minute habit","Wait for it...","One sticky note","Just one priority","On your mirror","Follow for small habits"],"cta":"FOLLOW","visuals":["hand holding a stopwatch showing one minute","blurred mystery object under a cloth","pen writing on a yellow sticky note","note with a single line written","sticky note pressed onto a bathroom mirror","quiet bedroom at night, lamp off"],"tania":["surprise","doubt","thoughtful","serious","joy","joy"],"why":"The viewer waits for the reveal, and the answer is so small and doable that it feels worth saving."},
{"id":7,"hook_type":"direct address with action","hook":"Close the laptop. Walk around the block.","spoken":"Close the laptop. Walk around the block. Ten minutes after dinner, no headphones, just you and the evening air. Let your legs do the work while your head slows down. You come home ready to rest. A stronger you starts tonight. Follow for more.","captions":["Close the laptop","Walk around the block","Ten minutes, no headphones","Evening air","Head slows down","A stronger you"],"cta":"FOLLOW","visuals":["hand closing a laptop on a desk","woman stepping out of an apartment door at dusk","quiet street walk, golden hour","trees and soft evening sky","legs walking on a sidewalk, tracking shot","woman entering home, smiling, warm hallway"],"tania":["serious","joy","thoughtful","joy","thoughtful","joy"],"why":"Two direct commands in the first line give a clear action right away, and the walk is easy to picture."},
{"id":8,"hook_type":"concrete object","hook":"One mug can end your evening scroll.","spoken":"One mug can end your evening scroll. Make a caffeine-free tea and drink it at the table, no screens.
